title: どんぐりころころ (Donguri Korokoro — The Rolling Acorn)
description: A beloved Taisho-era children's song about a round acorn that rolls into a pond. A friendly loach fish invites it to play, and they enjoy a wonderful time together — but the little acorn misses its mountain and starts to cry, leaving the loach in a muddle. Published 1921; considered one of Japan's three greatest children's songs. Two charming verses with simple, vivid vocabulary ideal for N5 learners.
license: Public Domain (lyrics: 青木存義 d. 1935, music: 梁田貞 d. 1959 — both copyrights expired)
